data.about: A gable truss with nine equal loads on its two straight rafters. Because every top-chord force segment runs from the load line to one common vertical line, the force in the rafters is constant — the bottom chord is shaped as the funicular of the rays from that vertical to the division point i, and the web verticals become struts that each carry exactly one nodal load F, except the apex tie, which hangs the kink of the roof in tension. A hidden option of the original applet (the grey funicular polygon that proves the bottom-chord shape and the reactions) is ported behind a toggle.
